extraction_rule.sql: SELECT e.id FROM expenses e INNER JOIN accounts a ON a.id = e.expense_account_id WHERE a.country_id = :country_id
SELECT icc.id FROM inventory_cost_consumptions icc INNER JOIN inventory_cost_layers icl ON icl.id = icc.layer_id WHERE icl.country_id = :country_id

extraction_rule.description: Company documents linked to country-scoped entities via entity_table/entity_id
extraction_rule.sql: SELECT ocd.id FROM orange_company_documents ocd WHERE ocd.entity_table IN ('orders','purchases','customers','suppliers') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE ocd.entity_table = 'orders' AND o.id = CAST(ocd.entity_id AS UNSIGNED) AND o.country_id = :country_id UNION SELECT 1 FROM purchases p WHERE ocd.entity_table = 'purchases' AND p.id = CAST(ocd.entity_id AS UNSIGNED) AND p.country_id = :country_id UNION SELECT 1 FROM customers c WHERE ocd.entity_table = 'customers' AND c.id = CAST(ocd.entity_id AS UNSIGNED) AND c.country_id = :country_id UNION SELECT 1 FROM suppliers s WHERE ocd.entity_table = 'suppliers' AND s.id = CAST(ocd.entity_id AS UNSIGNED) AND s.country_id = :country_id)

extraction_rule.description: Pending GL movements scoped via journal_vouchers.country_id
extraction_rule.sql: SELECT ogpm.id FROM orange_gl_pending_movements ogpm INNER JOIN journal_vouchers jv ON jv.id = ogpm.journal_voucher_id WHERE jv.country_id = :country_id
SELECT ps.id FROM party_subledger ps INNER JOIN journal_vouchers jv ON jv.id = ps.voucher_id WHERE jv.country_id = :country_id

extraction_rule.description: Party subledger allocations scoped via payment journal_vouchers.country_id
extraction_rule.sql: SELECT psa.id FROM party_subledger_allocations psa INNER JOIN journal_vouchers jv ON jv.id = psa.payment_voucher_id WHERE jv.country_id = :country_id

extraction_rule.description: Purchase returns scoped via purchase_id → purchases.country_id or supplier_id → suppliers.country_id
extraction_rule.sql: SELECT pr.id FROM purchase_returns pr LEFT JOIN purchases p ON p.id = pr.purchase_id LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON s.id = pr.supplier_id WHERE (p.id IS NOT NULL AND p.country_id = :country_id) OR (p.id IS NULL AND s.country_id = :country_id)
